Maddie: Heads-up — we just accepted a drumset case + two small parcels for a 3pm visitor (Ben from Drumsmith). It’s bulky, might need dolly. :drum:
Liam (Front Desk): Saw it. It’s by the side door in a single crate labeled "Ben / Drumsmith". I can tag it and move to the staging shelf if someone can help with the case weight. :handshake:
Sasha: I can swing by at 2:50 and help lug it in. Also do we need temp badges for him?
Maddie: Yes please — temp badge + visitor wifi. Can you print and leave with the crate? Use visitor lanyards (blue).
Tom: @Liam can you set a locker for the small parcels? I’ll collect them after import. Prefer Locker 4A if free.
Liam (Front Desk): Locker 4A free. Putting the two parcels in 4A now, code: 1947 (write it on the crate). I’ll leave a sticky with the code. :pushpin:
Courier Bot: Delivery scan: 1 crate (drumset) — size: large, weight: 28kg; 2 parcels — frag: Yes. Recorded at 14:07.
Sasha: Quick poll — who wants the lobby chair by the windows? We have only one left after rearrange. React with :raised_hand: if you want it; otherwise I’ll put it in the media room.
Tom: :raised_hand: I could use it for quick calls this afternoon.
Maddie: Thanks everyone. @Ben we’ll meet you curbside at 3. Front desk will hand-off badge + locker note. :wave:
